question.question: Who inspired Dave's passion for car engineering?

evidence_items.text: - On 2023-10-25, when asked (by Calvin) what got him into engineering cars, gave a second, complementary origin story: cars have "always been [his] thing" — his dad took him to his first car show when he was 10, he was "wow-ed," and "I was hooked and wanted to learn more"; now he's an automotive engineer, and it's "crazy to think that something so powerful and cool can be made from small parts" (complements the 2023-10-23 origin story — fascination with machines at ten and the neighbor's old car — in the Hobbies and sense of purpose section of this file; Calvin: "So happy you followed your dreams and became an engineer. Seeing you work on cars is inspiring - it makes me want to keep pushing my music.") [S26T6][S26T7].

- On 2023-10-23, caught up with Calvin, picking back up a chat they'd had "the other day" about fame and its impact on relationships (a chat not otherwise recorded in this memory): asked how the tour with Frank Ocean is going — "It must be awesome but it must have its own struggles too" — and how Calvin juggles his job plus his personal life; Calvin: the tour's been incredible — performing and connecting with the crowd energizes him — but fame has its own challenges and balancing everything is tough [S25T1][S25T2]. Dave asked how he manages and whether he ever feels overwhelmed; Calvin: he takes it one day at a time, but it can get overwhelming with so many demands — still, he enjoys what he does so he pushes on [S25T3][S25T4]. Dave asked for strategies that help Calvin manage everything; Calvin: having a strong support system is really helpful — his friends and team keep him on track — and Dave agreed that having people who understand and support you is really important [S25T5][S25T6]. Dave then told Calvin he recently had a good conversation with some neighbors about current events and politics — it was nice to hear different perspectives and share their own — and that interacting like that cheers him up and helps him stay informed, and asked Calvin how he stays informed; Calvin: staying connected and up-to-date on world events is important to him — it helps his music stand out by incorporating unique perspectives, connects him better with his fans, and keeps him motivated and inspired (Calvin's side in the 2023-10-23 entry of the Relationships section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T7][S25T8]. The conversation then turned to art: Dave said "Art is amazing how it reflects the world" and asked whether anything had caught Calvin's eye lately and made an impact on his music; Calvin: yes — recently he's been really inspired by the struggles that people go through, and it's made him dig deeper into his music to try to capture those feelings [S25T9][S25T10]. Dave asked whether using his music to share experiences and feelings is cathartic for him; Calvin: it's a way for him to express himself and work through his emotions — "like my own form of therapy" (Calvin's details in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T11][S25T12]. Dave said he gets it — cars give him an outlet to express himself, "like a little oasis of calm," and working on one is "like I'm connecting back with myself" — and that the music helps too; he shared a photo of his garage (a garage with a bunch of tools hanging on the wall — "a little dirty, but everything is in its place"; details in ## Car maintenance shop) [S25T13]. Calvin: "Looking cool — what made you start working on cars?"; Dave: ever since he was ten he's been fascinated with how machines work — he found an old car in a neighbor's garage, asked if he could fix it, and that's when his love for car engineering began — he enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made him hooked, so he's been working on cars ever since (shared a photo of a man working on a car in a garage; details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S25T14][S25T15]. Calvin: "Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life." and asked whether it was a classic car and whether Dave still has it or is currently working on another project [S25T16]; Dave answered in the continuation of the chat: "Thanks Calvin! It was a fun project. I restored a car last year, but I sold it to a collector" (the 2022 restoration — see ## Classic cars), "Now I'm working on something new, and it's quite a challenge!" — sharing a photo of his new project car (a black car parked in a parking lot — "Take a look at this wonderful car!") [S25T17]. Calvin: "Cool! Been wanting to try that. What would you say is the toughest part of car restoration?" — Dave: it takes a lot of patience but the payoff is worth it, and paying extra attention to detail isn't easy but it pays off [S25T18][S25T19]. Calvin: details "can really make a difference" and are what makes something great — "like a well-crafted rap song or a sleek and stylish car" [S25T20]; Dave: paying attention to details "makes a big difference, whether it's in music or with vehicles" — little things can make a big impact [S25T21]. Calvin: without those details it's just average, and as an artist he wants to create something extraordinary — sharing a photo of his record (a silver disc in a black frame on a table; Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T22]; Dave: he loves the attention to detail in Calvin's work — "it makes it extra special. Keep on creating!" — sharing a photo of his brown amp (a brown amp with a black knob and a brown cover; Dave's side in the Music section of /memories/dave.md) [S25T23]; Calvin: "Thanks Dave! Appreciate your support!" [S25T24]. The chat then turned to concerts: Dave, glad that Calvin liked his garage, said the good times he's had at concerts last month (~September 2023 — e.g., the Boston rock concert ~2023-09-09/10, see ## Music) remind him that "music has a way of connecting us and making memories" — "Take a look at this picture, the atmosphere was amazing!" (shared a photo of a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air); Calvin: "Music has a way of bringing us together and creating unforgettable memories. It's unbeatable in terms of the energy it brings." (shared a photo of a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air); Dave: "Concerts are awesome, they bring people together and create such a cool vibe. You can feel the energy in the air." — sharing another photo from a concert (a crowd of people standing around a stage — "this unforgettable moment that I captured"); Calvin: "Concerts are what I live for - the indescribable connection between the artist and the crowd is just amazing!" — which Dave marveled at ("So glad you get to experience that!") [S25T25][S25T26][S25T27][S25T28][S25T29]; Calvin: "It's a rush connecting with everyone. That feeling is unbeatable! Wishing you a harmonious day ahead, my friend!" [S25T30]; Dave: "I can imagine it's a rush being up on stage with all the fans cheering. Must be a unique experience. Wishing you many more electrifying moments in the spotlight! See you soon!" — the conversation closed [S25T31].
- On 2023-10-25, caught up with Calvin ("Hey Calvin! Long time no talk!"): Calvin told him he had a great time the day before (2023-10-24), visiting some sights in Boston with a high school friend — "It was really fun and eye-opening"; Dave: "Sounds like you had a blast in Boston - so much to do there!" and mentioned one of his favorites there that's "great for chilling and admiring nature" (his Boston parks — details in ## Boston and ## Parks); Calvin: "I had a wonderful experience during my time in Boston. It had awesome architecture and a really cool history. I followed your advice and went there, it was so peaceful." [S26T1][S26T2][S26T3]. Dave then told Calvin he recently attended a conference in Detroit — "it was so cool, I learned a lot" (details in the Car workshops in San Francisco section of this file); Calvin: "Good to hear that you've learned a lot of new things at the conference in Detroit!" [S26T2][S26T3]. The chat then turned to Dave's latest car project — he shared a photo (a group of people washing a car in a garage) and said working on this "takes me out of my head and calms me down" (details in ## Classic cars and ## Hobbies and sense of purpose); Calvin: "Dave, that car looks awesome! What got you into engineering cars? I'm totally into cars too and love making new and powerful models." (Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S26T4][S26T5]. Dave answered that cars have "always been my thing": his dad took him to his first car show when he was 10, he was "wow-ed" and "hooked" and wanted to learn more — now he's an automotive engineer, and it's "crazy to think that something so powerful and cool can be made from small parts" (a complementary origin story to the 2023-10-23 account in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose); Calvin: "That's awesome, Dave! So happy you followed your dreams and became an engineer. Seeing you work on cars is inspiring - it makes me want to keep pushing my music." [S26T6][S26T7]. Calvin then shared a photo of himself performing in a nightclub (a DJ at a DJ table) with someone he admires — "Check this out - a pic of me performing with someone I admire! So amazing!" (Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "Wow, Calvin! That's amazing! You looked super comfortable on stage. Bet it was an incredible experience to perform with someone you admire. How did it feel being up there?" [S26T7][S26T8]. Calvin: being "up there with someone I admire" was "unreal" — "a dream come true" — and the energy and the crowd made him realize how much music means to him — "it's like my passion and my purpose" (Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S26T9]. Dave: "That's great, Calvin. We both have discovered something that brings us fulfillment. It's a fortunate thing for us." [S26T10]. Calvin: it's awesome to find something that makes them happy — fulfilling and motivating too — and he's glad they're "on this journey together" and curious to see what happens next [S26T11]. Dave: "Me too, Calvin! Let's see where it takes us. We can keep inspiring each other!" [S26T12]. Calvin: let's "keep inspiring each other to be our best selves" and urges Dave to "keep going for your passion, buddy" [S26T13]; Dave: "Thanks, Calvin! Same to you! Keep pursuing your passion and keep dreaming. We got this!" [S26T14]; the chat closed with Calvin thanking Dave for his support and saying they'll "keep pushing for our goals" — "Catch you later, see ya!" — and Dave: "Got to go, see you soon!" [S26T15].

evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-08-03, said fixing cars is like therapy for him; growing up he worked on cars with his dad, and refurbishing them gives him a sense of fulfillment [S12T2].
- On 2023-09-02, when telling Calvin he's been tied up with car stuff, said fixing stuff up and seeing it turn out better is "really rewarding and gives me a sense of purpose", and that fixing someone's car makes him feel like he's "making a difference"; he's made "proud" to see the relief on someone's face when their car is fixed (echoing his long-stated sense of purpose from fixing things, see above) [S17T3][S17T5].
- Has fond memories of working on cars with his dad as a kid: they spent one summer restoring an old car — "It was hard work, but seeing the end result and knowing that we did it together was really satisfying" [S12T4].

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-10-08, when telling Calvin about his car show and restored/modified car (details in ## Classic cars), said working on cars "is not just a hobby, it's a passion" — it's "like therapy, a way to get away from everyday stress"; as a kid he'd spend hours in his dad's garage, tinkering with engines — "it was like my own sanctuary" (echoing his childhood memories of working on cars with his dad, see above); now he's "lucky enough to do this as a job, to take something broken and make it into something awesome" [S22T5].
- On 2023-10-08, said doing what he loves has been "my goal since I was a kid" and it's awesome that he's able to do it; restoring things can be tough but "the feeling of accomplishment it gives is great"; Calvin responded that bringing broken things back to life is "so satisfying," that working on cars "can be a real escape from reality" (he understands the feeling), and that "doing what you love for a living, that's the ultimate goal," adding "Keep going with it, it's really inspiring." [S22T5][S22T6][S22T7].
- On 2023-10-23, told Calvin he recently had a good conversation with some neighbors about current events and politics — it was nice to hear different perspectives and share their own; he finds that interacting like that cheers him up and helps him stay informed (conversation flow in the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships; Calvin's response in the Music and Relationships sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T7].
- On 2023-10-23, told Calvin (who asked "what made you start working on cars?") that his car passion started when he was ten: he'd been fascinated with how machines work, found an old car in a neighbor's garage, and asked if he could fix it — "that's when my love for car engineering began!" — he enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made him hooked, so he's been working on cars ever since (shared a photo of a man working on a car in a garage; comes with his remark that working on a car is his outlet — "a little oasis of calm" — where he's "connecting back with myself" — see the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships; complements the childhood memories of tinkering with engines in his dad's garage recorded above; Calvin: "Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life.", and asked whether it was a classic car and whether Dave still has it or is working on another project — Dave answered in the continuation of the same day's chat, which is not in this excerpt: he restored a car last year (2022, the 2022 restoration, see above) but sold it to a collector, and is now working on a new car project he finds quite a challenge [S25T14][S25T15][S25T16][S25T17].
